areas.t: Tuesday through Thursday, a ridge of high pressure aloft will slowly develop over the region, reducing atmospheric mixing over Louisiana. However, with a persistent surface ridge to the northeast, and low pressure lingering over the Gulf, light to moderate northeasterly winds will continue disperse
